clearly_out_status: NONE FOUND. This judging pass found no pair in click certain enough to call a false positive. click's reports concentrate on its test suite, where repetition is genuine but idiomatic - those pairs are recorded below as NOT CLEAR. An empty list asserts nothing and must never be read as evidence that precision is good.
